description: This file defines data models for various Balance of Payments (BoP) components, including classes for OECD BP6 data, ECB main, summary, services, investment income, direct investment, portfolio investment, other investment, and country-specific BoP data, utilizing Pydantic for data validation and type annotations.

classes.name: BalanceOfPaymentsQueryParams
classes.description: Query parameters class for Balance of Payments queries.

classes.name: BP6BopUsdData
classes.description: Data model for OECD BP6 Balance of Payments items in USD, including various financial metrics and percentages.

classes.name: ECBMain
classes.description: Model representing ECB's main balance of payments items in EUR, including current, capital, financial accounts, and investment components.

classes.name: ECBSummary
classes.description: Model for ECB's summarized balance of payments data, including credits, debits, and balances for various components.

classes.name: ECBServices
classes.description: Model for ECB services balance of payments items, covering different service categories and their credits/debits.

classes.name: ECBInvestmentIncome
classes.description: Model for ECB investment income components, including equity, debt, and portfolio investments with credits and debits.

classes.name: ECBDirectInvestment
classes.description: Model for ECB direct investment assets and liabilities, segmented by sector and instrument.

classes.name: ECBPortfolioInvestment
classes.description: Model for ECB portfolio investment assets and liabilities, including equity, debt, and fund shares.

classes.name: ECBOtherInvestment
classes.description: Model for ECB other investments, covering various asset and liability categories.

classes.name: ECBCountry
classes.description: Model representing balance of payments data by country, including current account, goods, services, income, and capital components.
